scope: Local Chromium production-build checks; automated accessibility and synthetic composition only, not device or screen-reader certification.

cases.name: fresh memory-only, local assets/CSP, real WASM and independent/native metrics
Unicode accept/Undo preserves adopted source; typing clears accept history; exact export
late actual Worker responses are ignored after edits
composition suppresses checks and actions until committed; pause terminates Worker
opt-in draft restore, opt-out removal, and scoped clear preserve current/unrelated data
restored CRLF/CR adopts LF consistently for DOM, analysis, accept/Undo and export
storage denial/quota and malformed saved records remain editable
malformed draft is not imported
unknown-version draft is not imported
invalid-format draft is not imported
oversized draft is not imported
malformed-Unicode draft is not imported
storage read denial is bounded and analysis stays available
Markdown source protects code/link/HTML and omits incomplete grade estimates
UTF-8 input cap and malformed UTF-16 do not produce success or repaired export
dense real results render bounded cards with truthful total
controlled Worker asset failure has truthful error and real retry recovery
local library save/search/rename/duplicate/delete and reload preserve exact source
denied IndexedDB Save stays unsaved while local checking works
SAF-style local file import adopts LF and rejects invalid UTF8 without replacing source
optional AI starts unconfigured and no text request occurs without explicit consent
AI protocol fixture Apply/Undo preserves Unicode, literal text, consent and provenance
AI protocol fixture rejects stale Apply and cancellation leaves the source unchanged
AI rate-limit and mismatched-response protocol fixtures never change the source
offline static shell restores only explicitly saved local documents and never caches API data
320px keyboard, light/dark, reduced motion and forced colors remain operable
